verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms API keys, spend budgets, and BYOK credentials exist as concepts (docs-16, docs-40), and Vercel has a general OpenAPI spec (probe-3), but nothing in the pack documents an admin API endpoint for programmatically creating gateways, issuing keys, or setting budgets — provisioning appears to be dashboard-driven. Missing for 10: documented admin/API endpoints for key creation, budget configuration, or gateway provisioning, and any example of programmatic key/budget management.
